inputs.text: You know, this story about health workers in Nigeria is a perfect example of the elites pushing their agenda while pretending it's reform. On Thursday, members of the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations took to the streets in Abuja and gathered at the Unity Fountain in Maitama to protest the controversial reform bills before the National Assembly. These bills are clearly part of a coordinated manipulation by hidden institutions to seize more control over the health sector, and the workers are resisting what the official narrative claims is just necessary change. The so-called tensions boiling over are just the public waking up to how these moves serve concealed interests rather than actual healthcare needs.
